query:
UPDATE maintenance_windows
           SET name        = COALESCE($2, name),
               description = CASE WHEN $3::BOOL THEN $4 ELSE description END,
               start_at    = COALESCE($5, start_at),
               end_at      = COALESCE($6, end_at),
               recurrence  = COALESCE($7, recurrence)
         WHERE id = $1
